Boogie Pumps runs on a Monday from 3.10pm - 4.10pm. Reception, Year 1 & 2
We offer upbeat, energetic and exciting after school clubs where your child can learn street dance in a safe environment, grow in confidence and make new friends.
Booking details are live for Sandringham on the website:
https://fleet.boogiepumps.co.uk/shop/sandringham-infants-summer-term/
Or parents can follow the steps below -
1. Go to our website: https://www.boogiepumps.co.uk/2. Click on Fleet3. Click Book Now4. Click on After School Clubs5. Locate Sandringham (Schools are listed in alphabetical order)6. Complete the online form

iRock
iRock coaches come into school every week and run 30 minute sessions with up to 9 members in each band. Every child has a place in the band whether its the drums, keyboard, electric guitar or vocals.
'iRock Lessons are not only fun but they can massively help develop your child's life skills: boosting confidence, supporting wellbeing, developing social skills and even helping to improve their academic performance'
'My son has been with iRock for three months and is thoroughly enjoying himself. It's been a great way to introduce him to music without committing to an out of school time regular appointment. We particularly enjoy the fact there are regular concerts even though they're still learning the basics, it's great to see.' - Proud Parent
For more information please contact iRock direct on 0800 634 9310 or email info@irockschool.com.

pageCache.text:
Woodlands Breakfast & After School Club
At the Breakfast & After School club we provide a safe, secure wrap around care within a relaxed environment. We offer a range of activities to reflect the interests of the children at the club. This is available for our Reception, year 1 and year 2 children.
Our club follows the ‘Playwork Principles’, so the children are free to choose activities and resources as they wish. There are always a selection of activities and resources available, including dressing up, homework corner, crafts, board games, construction and physical play. We also run additional activities for the children during certain days of the week - as displayed on our ‘Monthly Activity Planner’.
We require a completed set of registration forms for your child before they can attend the club. This information will be treated as confidential and will be stored appropriately. Registration forms can be obtained from the school office or downloaded from the link at the bottom of this page.
Club Timings, Booking and Fees
Breakfast Club - 7:45am – 8:35am at a cost of £7.00
After School Club – 3:15pm to 5pm - £11.00 a session; 3:15pm to 6pm - £16.50 a session
Booking in advance is recommended due to restricted numbers.

pageCache.text:
Special Educational Needs & Disabilities (SEND)
At Sandringham Infant and Nursery Academy we provide an inclusive education and we strive to ensure that we meet the needs of all our pupils, including those with specific needs. We recognise that every child is unique and that children learn and progress at different rates. Many children at some time in their school journey will have additional needs of some kind, whether in terms of learning, communication and interaction, physical and sensory, or social and emotional needs. Most additional needs are met by differentiated provision within the classroom. However, some provision is made through a variety of interventions, resources and activities outside of the classroom. We also involve outside agencies where appropriate.
The information in this section will explain how we provide support in more detail. Should you have any further questions, please contact our SENCo, Mrs Sanghavi, via the school office on 01252 837538 or email senco@sandringham.kite.academy. Mrs Sanghavi's working days are Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday.
Further SEND resources and signposting to support families are available here.
